تعلوطي (form XIII)
# تَعْلَوِّطِي (taʕlawwiṭī) /taʕ.law.wi.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# تُعْلَوَّطِي (tuʕlawwaṭī) /tuʕ.law.wa.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
